map.CAPE对流有效位能 使用指南: CAPE convective available potential energy user guide
map.→ 打开CAPE对流有效位能工具: -> Open the CAPE convective available potential energy tool
map.判断场址是否达开发风速门槛（如 5–6 m/s 年均）。: Judge whether the site meets the development wind speed threshold (such as an annual 5-6 m/s).
map.我国分 1–4 类（≥400/300/250/200 W/m² 递减），越高越优: China grades these from 1 to 4 (>=400/300/250/200 W/m2, descending); a higher class means better quality.
map.用威布尔分布估年发电量。: Estimate annual energy generation with a Weibull distribution.
map.由测风塔风速序列估风功率密度。: Estimate wind power density from a wind mast wind speed series.
map.输入气块温度、环境温度及自由对流高度(LFC)和平衡高度(EL)气压，计算对流有: Enter the parcel temperature, ambient temperature and the pressures at the level of free convection (LFC) and equilibrium level (EL) to compute CAPE and the theoretical maximum updraft speed.
map.风功率∝风速立方，风速翻倍功率约 8 倍，所以选址对风速极敏感。: Wind power is proportional to the cube of wind speed, so doubling the wind speed gives about 8 times the power; site selection is therefore extremely sensitive to wind speed.

map.风速翻倍发电量几倍？: How much more energy does doubling the wind speed produce?
map.：空气密度 1.225、年均风速 7 m/s → 风功率密度=0.5×1.225: : air density 1.225 and an annual mean wind speed of 7 m/s give a wind power density = 0.5*1.225*7^3 ≈ 210 W/m2, a class 2-3 wind regime with development value.
map.：轮毂高 80m、风速≥3 m/s 占比 85% → 年可利用约 7446h，配: : hub height 80 m, with wind speed >= 3 m/s for 85% of the time, gives about 7446 usable hours per year; combine this with the power curve to estimate energy yield.
